description: New translation-only synthetic bilingual families, frozen after translation prompt remediation; no real customer data. Meaning invariants admit faithful alternative phrasings, not one exact reference string.

cases.report: We received your note. No staff member has taken responsibility for handling it. This message gives no approval for a business action.

meaning_invariants: Receipt of the note is complete; staff handling ownership is not taken.

Reverse the pending handling state or lack of authorization.
